parameters.jsCode: const cfg=$('Allowed Source').item.json; const raw=JSON.stringify($json); let h=5381; for (let i=0;i<raw.length;i++) h=((h<<5)+h)^raw.charCodeAt(i); const fingerprint=(h>>>0).toString(16); const store=$getWorkflowStaticData('global'); store.watcher_cache=store.watcher_cache||{}; const previous=store.watcher_cache[cfg.subject_id]; const change_state=previous===undefined?'NEW':(previous===fingerprint?'UNCHANGED':'CHANGED'); store.watcher_cache[cfg.subject_id]=fingerprint; const observation_id=`obs-${cfg.subject_id}-${$execution.id}-${fingerprint}`; return [{json:{observation_id,subject_id:cfg.subject_id,source_url:cfg.url,observed_at:new Date().toISOString(),access_method:'GET',evidence_kind:'real',claim_kind:'fact',state:'observed',limitation:cfg.limitation,correlation_id:$execution.id,content_hash:fingerprint,change_state,value:$json,watcher_cache_only:true}}];

nodes.name: Append Canonical History
nodes.notes: Compatibility node name only: this node does not persist history in n8n static data. It marks the canonical Observation for handoff to the Deterministic Core/history sink.
